features.title: Durable fabric that’s made to last
features.text: Upholstered in premium fabric, this sofa resists stains and wear, making it ideal for homes with busy lifestyles or pets.

features.title: Mid-backrest that supports your posture
features.text: The mid-back design offers excellent lumbar support, ensuring you stay comfortable whether you’re reading, working, or just relaxing.

features.title: Generous armrests for support and relaxation
features.text: Features wide armrests that facilitate ergonomic seating, providing ample support in multiple postures.

features.title: Soft foam for sinking comfort
features.text: Features soft foam cushioning for a plush and comfortable seating experience that adapts to you.

features.title: Sleek raised legs for modern convenience
features.text: Raised legs give the sofa a lighter look and make cleaning the surrounding area effortless, helping you maintain a tidy home.
